- Do not change tests.
- Commit as `fix(shared): include nested source files in the DTS build (#2)`, authored as the owner with your co-author trailer, as in AGENTS.md.
- Push to the existing branch `day-02/session-format`. Do not open a new PR.

Checks you must run before pushing: `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build`. All must pass.
